title: The exchange rate puzzle and the systematic component of monetary policy: Evidence from Mexico
title_zh: 汇率之谜与货币政策的系统性成分：来自墨西哥的证据
title_primary: 汇率之谜与货币政策的系统性成分：来自墨西哥的证据
title_secondary: The exchange rate puzzle and the systematic component of monetary policy: Evidence from Mexico
authors: Jesús Eduardo López-Mares, Rogelio Varela-Llamas, Juan Manuel Ocegueda-Hernández
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper revisits the exchange rate puzzle following contractionary monetary policy shocks in a small open economy. Using a Bayesian SVAR for Mexico, we compare three cumulative identification schemes: pure sign restrictions on impulse response functions (IRFs), a closed-economy Taylor-type rule with contemporaneous sign and zero restrictions, and an exchange-rate-augmented rule. Neither pure sign restrictions nor the closed-economy rule yields a precisely estimated overshooting pattern—only the augmented rule does. Robust to alternative specifications, these results suggest that omitting the exchange rate from the systematic component of monetary policy may hinder shock identification in small open economies.
abstract_zh: 本文重新审视了小型开放经济体中紧缩性货币政策冲击后的汇率之谜。本文使用墨西哥的贝叶斯结构向量自回归模型，比较了三种累积识别方案：对脉冲响应函数（IRFs）的纯符号约束、具有同期符号约束和零约束的封闭经济泰勒型规则，以及一个汇率扩展规则。纯符号约束和封闭经济规则均未得到精确估计的超调模式——只有扩展规则得到了。这些结果在替代设定下具有稳健性，表明将汇率从货币政策的系统性成分中省略，可能会妨碍小型开放经济体中的冲击识别。

title: Zombie firms in emerging Asia: domestic and cross border implications
title_zh: 亚洲新兴市场的僵尸企业：国内与跨境影响
title_primary: 亚洲新兴市场的僵尸企业：国内与跨境影响
title_secondary: Zombie firms in emerging Asia: domestic and cross border implications
authors: Boris Hofmann, Xiaoxi Liu, Ilhyock Shim
official: 官方在线 2026-09-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Using firm-bank linked data for 10 Asian emerging market economies (EMEs) over 2005–2021, we study the domestic and cross-border implications of zombie firms. We document three main findings. First, the number of zombie firms in emerging Asia has increased significantly over the past 15 years, sustained by evergreening practices from weak banks. Second, zombie prevalence domestically depresses firm performance, crowds out healthy firms, and depresses inflation and GDP growth. Third, the macroeconomic effects of zombie firms extend across borders: expo sure to zombie firms in Asian EMEs significantly reduces inflation and growth in advanced economies. These spillover effects operate mainly through global value chains (GVCs) and an intermediate goods import price channel, while cross-border bank linkages do not play any major role.
abstract_zh: 利用2005至2021年间10个亚洲新兴市场经济体（EMEs）的企业-银行关联数据，我们研究了僵尸企业在国内及跨境层面的影响。我们记录了三个主要发现。第一，过去15年间，亚洲新兴市场中的僵尸企业数量显著增加，这得益于弱质银行的持续注资行为。第二，僵尸企业在国内的存在抑制了企业绩效，挤出了健康企业，并压低了通货膨胀和GDP增长。第三，僵尸企业的宏观经济效应跨越国界：亚洲新兴市场中的僵尸企业敞口显著降低了发达经济体的通胀和增长。这些溢出效应主要通过全球价值链（GVCs）和中间品进口价格渠道发挥作用，而跨境银行联系并未扮演重要角色。

title: How does coordinated land transfer promote the standardization of contracts?
title_zh: 协调土地流转如何促进合同标准化？
title_primary: 协调土地流转如何促进合同标准化？
title_secondary: How does coordinated land transfer promote the standardization of contracts?
authors: Jiao Long, Mingyong Hong
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-05 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Despite rapid expansion of farmland transfer in rural China, the quality of contractual governance often fails to keep pace, raising the question of whether spatial consolidation arrangements can promote more complete contract terms. This study examines how coordinated land transfer promotes the standardization of farmland rental contracts within China’s three-rights separation framework. Drawing on primary household survey data from 1101 farming households across four counties in Guizhou Province, this study documents a robust positive relationship between the degree of spatial contiguity in transfer arrangements and the level of contract standardization. Mediation analysis applying the KHB decomposition method reveals that this effect is transmitted primarily through two operational channels: economies of scale and technology adaptation through mechanization adoption. Heterogeneity analysis further reveals that the standardization effect concentrates among operators with greater financial capacity, in regions with stronger market connectivity and irrigation infrastructure, and in villages where collective governance is comparatively weak.
abstract_zh: 尽管中国农村土地流转规模迅速扩张，契约治理质量却往往未能同步提升，由此引发一个问题：空间整合安排能否促进更完整的契约条款？本研究考察在“三权分置”框架下，协调性土地流转如何推动农地租赁契约的标准化。基于贵州省四个县1101户农户的入户调查数据，研究发现流转安排的空间连片程度与契约标准化水平之间存在稳健的正向关系。采用KHB分解法的中介分析表明，这一效应主要通过两条运行渠道传导：规模经济与机械化采纳所引致的技术适应。异质性分析进一步揭示，标准化效应集中于资金能力较强的经营主体、市场连通性和灌溉基础设施较好的地区，以及集体治理相对薄弱的村庄。

title: Impacts of a partial welfare reform on targeting and political competition
title_zh: 部分福利改革对目标定位与政治竞争的影响
title_primary: 部分福利改革对目标定位与政治竞争的影响
title_secondary: Impacts of a partial welfare reform on targeting and political competition
authors: Pushkar Maitra, Sandip Mitra, Dilip Mookherjee, Sujata Visaria
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Over the past decade, India’s BJP-led national government has undertaken various reforms to welfare programs, aiming to reduce the scope for local officials to manipulate beneficiary selection or divert funds. Nevertheless state and local governments retained considerable discretion over beneficiary selection and the local delivery of central government funded welfare benefits, and have maintained exclusive control over state-funded programs. We use longitudinal household survey data from the state of West Bengal to evaluate the effects of these reforms on pro-poor targeting of welfare programs, and political competition between the BJP and the TMC, the incumbent political party in the state. We find that welfare programs were better targeted toward poorer and socially disadvantaged households in the period 2014–2018 than in 2010–2013. However the welfare reforms do not explain why the BJP’s vote share increased, as its electoral gains from the new nationwide programs were outweighed by their losses, stemming from the increased support for the TMC from recipients of new state and pre-existing benefits.
abstract_zh: 过去十年间，印度人民党领导的全国政府推行了多项福利项目改革，旨在减少地方官员操纵受益人筛选或挪用资金的空间。尽管如此，邦及地方政府在受益人筛选和中央政府资助福利项目的地方执行方面仍保留了大量自主权，并继续独家掌控邦资助项目。我们利用西孟加拉邦的纵向家庭调查数据，评估这些改革对福利项目扶贫定向效果及印度人民党与现任邦执政党草根国大党之间政治竞争的影响。研究发现，2014至2018年间，福利项目相较于2010至2013年更精准地覆盖了贫困和社会弱势家庭。然而，福利改革并未解释印度人民党得票率上升的原因，因为其从新全国性项目中获得的选举收益被因新邦级及既有福利项目受益者增加对草根国大党的支持而造成的损失所抵消。

title: Initial Output Losses from the Covid-19 Pandemic: Robust Determinants
title_zh: 新冠疫情初期产出损失：稳健的决定因素
title_primary: 新冠疫情初期产出损失：稳健的决定因素
title_secondary: Initial Output Losses from the Covid-19 Pandemic: Robust Determinants
authors: Davide Furceri, Michael Ganslmeier, Jonathan D. Ostry, Naihan Yang
official: 官方在线 2021-03-06 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: While the COVID-19 pandemic is affecting all countries, output losses vary considerably across countries. We provide a first analysis of robust determinants of observed initial output losses using model-averaging techniques—Weighted Average Least Squares and Bayesian Model Averaging. The results suggest that countries that experienced larger output losses are those with lower GDP per capita, more stringent containment measures, higher deaths per capita, higher tourism dependence, more liberalized financial markets, higher pre-crisis growth, lower fiscal stimulus, higher ethnic and religious fractionalization and more democratic regimes. With respect to the first factor, lower resilience of poorer countries reflects the higher economic costs of containment measures and deaths in such countries and less effective fiscal and monetary policy stimulus.
abstract_zh: 尽管新冠疫情影响了所有国家，但各国的产出损失差异显著。我们运用模型平均技术——加权平均最小二乘法与贝叶斯模型平均法，首次分析了观察到的初始产出损失的稳健决定因素。结果表明，产出损失较大的国家具有以下特征：人均GDP较低、防控措施更为严格、人均死亡人数较高、旅游业依赖度较高、金融市场更为自由化、危机前增长较快、财政刺激力度较小、种族与宗教分裂程度较高以及民主制度较为成熟。就第一个因素而言，较贫穷国家韧性较低，反映了这些国家防控措施和死亡带来的更高经济成本，以及财政和货币政策刺激效果较弱。

title: Gone with the wind: Productive response to agricultural shock
title_zh: 随风而逝：农业冲击的生产性应对
title_primary: 随风而逝：农业冲击的生产性应对
title_secondary: Gone with the wind: Productive response to agricultural shock
authors: Myriam Marending, Stefano Tripodi
official: 官方在线 2026-08-29 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Weather-induced agricultural shocks are geographically selective, as exposure reflects both exogenous atmospheric dynamics and predetermined local geography. We exploit the knowledge of shock determinants to isolate the exogenous component, relying on counterfactual simulations to measure medium-term farmers’ adaptation strategies. Using microdata from Ethiopia and an outbreak of desert locust swarms as source of the shock, we find a shift in agricultural production composition and an increase in household farm labour to smooth consumption. A producer–consumer approach reveals the farmers’ response not to be productivity-neutral in the medium-term, while individual factors’ intensity is used to offset a decrease in partial productivity. Estimating a Cobb–Douglas production function, we find a drop in total factor productivity in treated areas, a decline that exceeds the reduced-form output loss and indicates that available adaptive responses preserve subsistence output while carrying substantial productivity costs.
abstract_zh: 天气引发的农业冲击在地理上具有选择性，因为暴露程度既反映了外生的大气动态，也反映了既定的地方地理特征。我们利用对冲击决定因素的认知来分离外生成分，并依赖反事实模拟来衡量农民的中期适应策略。利用埃塞俄比亚的微观数据以及沙漠蝗虫群爆发作为冲击来源，我们发现农业生产结构发生转变，家庭农业劳动力增加以平滑消费。生产者—消费者方法揭示，农民的反应在中期并非生产力中性的，而个体因素的强度被用来抵消部分生产力的下降。通过估计柯布—道格拉斯生产函数，我们发现处理地区全要素生产率下降，这一降幅超过了简化形式产出损失，表明可用的适应性响应在维持生存产出的同时，承担了显著的生产力成本。

title: Self-Selection and the Diminishing Returns of Research
title_zh: 自我选择与研究的边际收益递减
title_primary: 自我选择与研究的边际收益递减
title_secondary: Self-Selection and the Diminishing Returns of Research
authors: Ekerdt, Lorenz K.F., Wu, Kai-Jie
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: We argue that a substantial portion of the downward historical trend in U.S. research productivity is a composition effect resulting from self-selection in researcher ability and the dramatic expansion of the research sector. Estimating a Roy-like model of researcher supply using 1960- 2021 U.S. microdata, we find that this composition effect has lowered average researcher ability by between 37% and 53%, depending on specification. Adjusting for efficiency units attenuates the decline in researcher productivity by the same proportion, implying significant upward revisions in long-run growth predicted by a broad class of growth models.
abstract_zh: 我们认为，美国研究生产率历史性下降趋势的相当大一部分是一种构成效应，源于研究者能力的自我选择以及研究部门的急剧扩张。利用1960-2021年美国微观数据估计一个罗伊式研究者供给模型，我们发现，这种构成效应已将平均研究者能力降低了37%至53%，具体幅度取决于模型设定。按效率单位调整后，研究者生产率的下降幅度按相同比例减弱，这意味着广泛类别的增长模型所预测的长期增长将得到显著上调。

title: Survival and Financial Literacy in Investment Decisions Later in Life
title_zh: 晚年投资决策中的生存与金融素养
title_primary: 晚年投资决策中的生存与金融素养
title_secondary: Survival and Financial Literacy in Investment Decisions Later in Life
authors: Francesca Parodi, Chiara Dal Bianco, Francesco Maura, Guglielmo Weber
official: 官方在线 2026-08-21 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study how subjective survival beliefs and financial literacy jointly shape saving and portfolio decisions later in life. Using data from the English Longitudinal Study of Ageing, we document that individuals who underestimate their survival probabilities are less likely to participate in risky financial markets. To identify the underlying mechanisms, we conduct a randomized survey experiment that cross-randomizes survival and financial literacy interventions and independently randomizes participation costs. Survival literacy updates subjective longevity beliefs, whereas financial literacy increases risky-asset participation by attenuating the deterrent effect of participation costs. We then build a heterogeneous-agent life-cycle model to evaluate survey-informed, revenue-neutral policy interventions. The counterfactuals show that financial literacy is the main driver of market entry, while survival literacy is complementary to financial literacy in raising the share of wealth invested in risky assets; only survival literacy, however, delivers positive welfare gains once financing costs are taken into account.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了主观生存信念与金融素养如何共同影响晚年储蓄及投资组合决策。利用英国老龄化纵向研究数据，我们发现低估自身生存概率的个体参与风险金融市场的可能性较低。为识别潜在机制，我们开展了一项随机调查实验，该实验交叉随机化生存干预与金融素养干预，并独立随机化参与成本。生存素养更新了主观寿命预期，而金融素养通过削弱参与成本的阻碍效应来提高风险资产参与度。随后，我们构建了一个异质性主体生命周期模型，以评估基于调查信息且收入中性的政策干预。反事实分析表明，金融素养是市场进入的主要驱动力，而生存素养在提高风险资产财富占比方面对金融素养具有互补作用；然而，仅生存素养在考虑融资成本后能带来正向福利收益。

title: Declining Occupations and Career Outcomes in the United States
title_zh: 美国衰退职业与职业结果
title_primary: 美国衰退职业与职业结果
title_secondary: Declining Occupations and Career Outcomes in the United States
authors: Erling Barth, Maria Forthun Hoen, Sari Pekkala Kerr, William R. Kerr
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study long-run career consequences of initial employment in an occupation that subsequently declines. Linking the 2000 Decennial Census to US administrative employment and earnings records through 2020, we follow more than 2.4 million workers. Employment in an occupation that contracts by at least 25 percent is associated with about 5 percent lower cumulative earnings despite slightly more quarters worked. The earnings differential closely matches evidence from Sweden and Norway, although employment adjustment differs. Occupational mobility is substantial but incomplete, while children’s later occupational destinations are much less tied to their household heads’ 2000 occupational-growth categories.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了初始就业于随后衰退的职业对长期职业生涯后果的影响。通过将2000年十年人口普查与美国行政就业及收入记录关联至2020年，我们追踪了超过240万名工人。在收缩至少25%的职业中就业，尽管工作季度数略多，但与累计收入降低约5%相关。这一收入差异与瑞典和挪威的证据高度吻合，尽管就业调整方式有所不同。职业流动性显著但不完全，而子女后来的职业去向与户主2000年职业增长类别的关联则大为减弱。

title: Labor Supply and Firm Size
title_zh: 劳动力供给与企业规模
title_primary: 劳动力供给与企业规模
title_secondary: Labor Supply and Firm Size
authors: Lin Shao, Faisal Sohail, Emircan Yurdagul
official: 官方在线 2026-08-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Larger firms feature (i) longer hours worked, (ii) higher wages, and (iii) smaller (larger) wage penalties for working long (short) hours. We reconcile these patterns in a general equilibrium model, which features the endogenous interaction of hours, wages, and firm size. In the model, workers willing to work longer hours sort into larger firms that offer a wage premium. Complementarities in hours generate wage penalties that increase with the distance from the usual hours. We use the model to argue that variation in average hours across firms contributes significantly to wage inequality.
abstract_zh: 大企业具有以下特征：（i）工作时间更长，（ii）工资更高，（iii）对长时间（短时间）工作的工资惩罚更小（更大）。我们在一个一般均衡模型中调和了这些模式，该模型包含了工作时间、工资与企业规模的内生互动。在模型中，愿意工作更长时间的工人会进入提供工资溢价的大企业。工作时间上的互补性产生了工资惩罚，这些惩罚随着与常规工作时间的距离增加而增大。我们利用该模型论证，企业间平均工作时间的差异对工资不平等有显著贡献。

title: Financial Interdependence and Currency Internationalization
title_zh: 金融相互依存与货币国际化
title_primary: 金融相互依存与货币国际化
title_secondary: Financial Interdependence and Currency Internationalization
authors: Zhengyang Jiang
official: 官方在线 2026-08-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Does financial opening necessarily lead to currency internationalization? To study the competition between incumbent and rising powers under financial interdependence, we develop a model of asset demand with microfounded network effects. Search frictions with currency-specialized intermediaries generate distinct notions of liquidity at asset-market and currency-area levels, which jointly shape the trajectory of currency competition. In the U.S.-China context, China at early stages of financial development benefits from pooling its assets with the dollar area, which reinforces the status quo. As China's financial markets deepen, RMB issuance allows China to internalize network effects and erode the dollar's dominance, triggering a discrete shift toward fragmentation. This transition is further shaped by sanctions, financial repression, and third-country responses, highlighting how financial interdependence transforms cooperation into rivalry in the evolution of the international financial order.
abstract_zh: 金融开放是否必然导致货币国际化？为研究金融相互依存下在位大国与新兴大国之间的竞争，我们构建了一个具有微观基础网络效应的资产需求模型。带有货币专业化中介的搜索摩擦在资产市场与货币区域两个层面产生了不同的流动性概念，二者共同塑造了货币竞争的轨迹。在中美背景下，中国在金融发展初期通过将其资产与美元区域合并而获益，这强化了现状。随着中国金融市场深化，人民币发行使中国能够内化网络效应并削弱美元的主导地位，从而引发向碎片化的离散转变。这一转变进一步受到制裁、金融抑制及第三国反应的影响，凸显了金融相互依存如何在国际金融秩序演变中将合作转化为竞争。

title: Progressive and Robust Scoring Rules: Axiomatic Taxonomy
title_zh: 渐进且稳健的评分规则：公理分类
title_primary: 渐进且稳健的评分规则：公理分类
title_secondary: Progressive and Robust Scoring Rules: Axiomatic Taxonomy
authors: Guy Barokas, S. Nitzan
official: 官方在线 2026-07-22 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Progressive social ranking rules assign greater weight to shifts in voters' preferences occurring lower in their ranking, potentially enhancing egalitarianism between individuals with more and with less favored alternatives, compared to non-progressive rules. Weakly robust ranking rules are not overly sensitive to the smallest admissible change in an individual’s preferences. We axiomatically characterize four classes of progressive and weakly robust ranking rules: the comprehensive class, the negative quadratic (NQ) class, the constant absolute inequality aversion (CAIA) class and, in a continuous setting, the constant relative inequality aversion (CRIA) class. We also identify the subclass satisfying a stronger robustness requirement that limits excessive sensitivity to bottom-rank changes. The rules within the CAIA class are parameterized by a variable β ∈ ( 1 , ∞ ) , representing progressivity levels. The Borda and inverse plurality rules are obtained as special cases at the lower and upper bounds of β . Selecting the appropriate rule within this class requires deciding upon the desired level of progressivity and we illustrate how one can opt for a context-dependent choice of β by employing the median voter theorem. Finally, we provide a complete taxonomy of our four classes and the Borda rule, which leads to the axiomatization of the negative squared Borda rule, demonstrating its unique position within the intersection of the NQ and CRIA classes.
abstract_zh: 渐进式社会排序规则赋予选民偏好中排名较低位置的变化以更大的权重，与非渐进式规则相比，这可能在拥有更受青睐和较少受青睐备选方案的个体之间增强平等主义。弱稳健排序规则对个体偏好中最小的可允许变化不过度敏感。我们公理化地刻画了四类渐进且弱稳健的排序规则：综合类、负二次（NQ）类、常数绝对不平等厌恶（CAIA）类，以及在连续设定下的常数相对不平等厌恶（CRIA）类。我们还识别出一个满足更强稳健性要求的子类，该要求限制了对底部排名变化的过度敏感性。CAIA类中的规则由参数β∈(1,∞)参数化，代表渐进性水平。博尔达规则和逆多数规则分别在β的下界和上界处作为特例获得。在此类中选择合适的规则需要决定所需的渐进性水平，我们通过运用中位选民定理说明如何根据情境选择β。最后，我们提供了我们四类规则与博尔达规则的完整分类体系，这引出了负平方博尔达规则的公理化，展示了其在NQ和CRIA类交集内的独特地位。

title: Generative AI-assisted investor communication and stock price crash risk
title_zh: 生成式AI辅助投资者沟通与股价崩盘风险
title_primary: 生成式AI辅助投资者沟通与股价崩盘风险
title_secondary: Generative AI-assisted investor communication and stock price crash risk
authors: Ruinan Cao, Zongxin Zhang
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study examines the effect of managerial responses assisted by generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) on stock price crash risk. Using question–response data from investor-relations platforms operated by Chinese stock exchanges, we employ large language models (LLMs) to measure the degree of GenAI assistance in managerial responses. We find that stronger GenAI-assisted textual features predict higher future stock price crash risk. We further show that greater response–question mismatch and more negative investor sentiment serve as two potential mechanisms, and that the effect is more pronounced among firms with more frequent investor interactions.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了生成式人工智能（GenAI）辅助的管理层回复对股价崩盘风险的影响。基于中国证券交易所投资者关系平台的问答数据，我们运用大语言模型（LLMs）测度管理层回复中GenAI辅助程度。研究发现，GenAI辅助文本特征越显著，未来股价崩盘风险越高。进一步分析表明，回复与问题匹配度降低及投资者负面情绪加剧是两条潜在作用机制，且该效应在投资者互动更频繁的企业中更为显著。

title: Cultural origins of preventive health care utilization
title_zh: 预防性医疗保健利用的文化起源
title_primary: 预防性医疗保健利用的文化起源
title_secondary: Cultural origins of preventive health care utilization
authors: Jan Bietenbeck, Lukas Maschmann, Therese Nilsson, Devon Spika
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We examine whether preventive health care uptake varies with cultural background related to patience and risk-taking. We combine individual-level survey data on preventive care use from 27 European countries with country-level preference measures from the Global Preferences Survey. To reduce confounding from institutional and economic correlates of culture, we focus on second-generation immigrants, who were born and currently reside in the same country – and thus face the same health care system and broad economic environment – but differ in inherited cultural background through their parents’ countries of origin. We find that respondents from more patient cultural backgrounds are more likely to use preventive services, while those from more risk-tolerant backgrounds are less likely to do so. These patterns appear across multiple preventive care outcomes.
abstract_zh: 本文考察预防性医疗服务的利用是否因与耐心和风险偏好相关的文化背景而异。我们将来自27个欧洲国家的个体层面预防性护理使用调查数据，与全球偏好调查中的国家层面偏好指标相结合。为减少文化与制度、经济因素之间的混杂效应，我们聚焦于第二代移民——他们出生并居住在同一国家，因此面临相同的医疗体系与宏观经济环境，但通过父母的原籍国继承了不同的文化背景。研究发现，来自更具耐心文化背景的受访者更倾向于使用预防性服务，而来自更具风险容忍背景的受访者则较少使用。这一模式在多种预防性护理结果中均得到体现。

title: Neighborhood Effects and Missing Markets for Opportunity
title_zh: 邻里效应与机会市场的缺失
title_primary: 邻里效应与机会市场的缺失
title_secondary: Neighborhood Effects and Missing Markets for Opportunity
authors: Lawrence F. Katz
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Experimental and quasi-experimental studies show that childhood neighborhoods have substantial causal impacts on children’s adult earnings and other long-term socioeconomic outcomes. Several market failures are likely to lead to excessive residential segregation by parental income and to an under-supply of mixed-income neighborhoods. Missing markets for opportunity originate in capital market imperfections for borrowing on children’s future earnings, neighbor spillovers, behavioral biases, and housing search frictions. Customized housing mobility services combined with subsidized housing vouchers can help low-income families move to higher-opportunity areas. Place-based policies that create mixed-income neighborhoods appear to increase long-term outcomes for less-advantaged children.
abstract_zh: 实验与准实验研究表明，童年居住社区对儿童成年后的收入及其他长期社会经济结果具有显著的因果影响。多种市场失灵可能导致按父母收入划分的居住隔离过度，并造成混合收入社区供给不足。机会缺失的市场源于儿童未来收入借贷的资本市场不完善、邻里溢出效应、行为偏差以及住房搜寻摩擦。定制化住房流动服务与补贴性住房券相结合，可帮助低收入家庭迁往机会更多的区域。创建混合收入社区的属地化政策似乎能改善弱势儿童的长期发展结果。

title: Social learning in agriculture: A scalable farmer-to-farmer extension approach for dairy farmers
title_zh: 农业中的社会学习：一种可扩展的奶农间推广方法
title_primary: 农业中的社会学习：一种可扩展的奶农间推广方法
title_secondary: Social learning in agriculture: A scalable farmer-to-farmer extension approach for dairy farmers
authors: Luc Behaghel, Jérémie Gignoux, Karen Macours
official: 官方在线 2026-07-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We evaluate a farmer training intervention for smallholder dairy farmers in Uganda, demonstrating that an at-scale version of the “contact farmer” extension model can significantly increase milk production and be cost-effective. In this model, one “farmer trainer” is selected per village and trained to disseminate knowledge to other farmers. Using experimental sub-treatment arms, and a combination of observed and self-reported data, we assess three key components designed to enhance the program’s impact: (i) non-monetary incentives for farmer trainers, (ii) support from professional extension agents, and (iii) a curriculum that combines key principles of animal nutrition and technology choice with a broad set of feeding practices. Results show positive impacts along the hypothesized causal chain, from knowledge acquisition by farmer trainers to knowledge of the farmers they train, and increases in their technology adoption, production, and profits.
abstract_zh: 我们评估了一项针对乌干达小农户奶牛养殖者的农民培训干预措施，证明“联络农民”推广模式的大规模版本能显著提高牛奶产量并具有成本效益。在此模式中，每个村庄选出一名“农民培训师”，接受培训后将知识传播给其他农民。通过实验性子处理组，结合观测数据与自我报告数据，我们评估了旨在增强项目影响力的三个关键组成部分：（i）对农民培训师的非货币激励，（ii）专业推广人员的支持，以及（iii）结合动物营养关键原则、技术选择与广泛饲养实践的课程。结果显示，沿着假设的因果链条产生了积极影响，从农民培训师获取知识，到他们所培训农民的知识增长，再到技术采纳、产量和利润的提升。

title: Trade policy uncertainty, organization of firms, and the form of international trade
title_zh: 贸易政策不确定性、企业组织与国际贸易形式
title_primary: 贸易政策不确定性、企业组织与国际贸易形式
title_secondary: Trade policy uncertainty, organization of firms, and the form of international trade
authors: Felix Fosu
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper investigates the hypothesis that lower trade policy uncertainty (TPU) reduces the share of intrafirm trade in total trade. A significant change in US‐China TPU occurred in 2001 when China joined the WTO, providing a natural experiment to test this hypothesis. Using a difference‐in‐differences approach with industry‐level US data, I examine the trade effects of this change. The results indicate that the reduction in TPU between the US and China led to a significant increase in both US arm's‐length and intrafirm imports from China compared to pre‐WTO levels. Notably, the effect of TPU on arm's‐length trade is approximately twice that on intrafirm trade, with the disparity largely attributed to sunk costs. A simple model of production location and ownership choice under policy uncertainty provides a conceptual framework for understanding these findings.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文研究了贸易政策不确定性（TPU）降低会减少公司内贸易在总贸易中占比这一假说。2001年中国加入WTO使美中贸易政策不确定性发生显著变化，为检验该假说提供了自然实验。本文采用双重差分法，基于美国行业层面数据，考察了这一变化带来的贸易效应。结果表明，相较于入世前水平，美中贸易政策不确定性的降低显著增加了美国从中国的独立企业间贸易和公司内进口。值得注意的是，贸易政策不确定性对独立企业间贸易的影响约为公司内贸易的两倍，这一差异主要归因于沉没成本。一个关于政策不确定性下生产区位与所有权选择的简单模型，为理解上述发现提供了概念框架。

title: Trading Institutions, Emotional Arousal, and Overbidding
title_zh: 交易制度、情绪唤醒与过度出价
title_primary: 交易制度、情绪唤醒与过度出价
title_secondary: Trading Institutions, Emotional Arousal, and Overbidding
authors: Nobuyuki Hanaki, Brice Corgnet, Camille Cornand
source: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
official: 官方在线 2026-06-27 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We investigate the influence of trading institutions on emotional arousal and bidding behavior through a series of behavioral and physiological experiments involving an investment task. In line with the competitive arousal hypothesis, we show that market institutions exacerbate the emotional arousal associated with winning bids, especially when buying an asset leads to substantial earnings. The market treatment exhibits stronger overbidding and bubble dynamics than baselines that use a Becker-DeGroot-Marschak mechanism. Treatment differences disappear for investors who exhibit no base rate emotional arousal. Our study shows that emotions are an important mechanism for understanding market outcomes and suggests designing new trading institutions to mitigate competitive arousal and subsequent overbidding in markets.
abstract_zh: 我们通过一系列涉及投资任务的行为与生理实验，探究了交易制度对情绪唤醒及竞价行为的影响。与竞争性唤醒假说一致，我们发现市场制度加剧了与中标相关的情绪唤醒，尤其是在购买资产能带来可观收益的情况下。相较于采用贝克尔-德格鲁特-马沙克机制的基线情境，市场处理表现出更强烈的过度竞价和泡沫动态。对于未表现出基础情绪唤醒的投资者，处理组间的差异消失。本研究显示，情绪是理解市场结果的重要机制，并建议设计新的交易制度以缓解市场中的竞争性唤醒及随之而来的过度竞价现象。

title: Learning at Scale: Infrastructure, Aid Effectiveness, and World Bank Performance
title_zh: 大规模学习：基础设施、援助有效性与世界银行绩效
title_primary: 大规模学习：基础设施、援助有效性与世界银行绩效
title_secondary: Learning at Scale: Infrastructure, Aid Effectiveness, and World Bank Performance
authors: Lall, Somik, Su, Xinyi, Vagliasindi, Maria
source: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
official: 官方在线 2026-06-09 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract_zh: 本文利用世界银行60年间2500个基础设施项目的事后经济回报率，重新审视援助有效性。研究发现三个事实：第一，平均价值创造水平较高——经济回报率均值为24%（中位数为18.5%）；第二，回报率随时间递增——在20世纪80年代中期前保持相对稳定后，自80年代末起经济回报率持续上升，这与项目筛选、设计及交付质量的改善相吻合；第三，制度薄弱国家的经济回报率系统性更高。在此类国家中，世界银行的高质量绩效可使平均经济回报率提升约12个百分点。其潜在机制在于人才配置：更优质的项目团队负责人被不成比例地分配到最具挑战性的环境中，尽管面临更长周期、更高强度的实施过程，却能显著缩短项目见效时间并提升经济回报率。总体而言，除国家基本面因素外，世界银行的绩效表现与人才配置能实质性提升稀缺资本的回报率——尤其在治理薄弱地区效果更为显著。

title: When Lasry-Lions meet Krugman: A mean-field game theory of spatial dynamics
title_zh: 当Lasry-Lions遇见Krugman：空间动力学的平均场博弈理论
title_primary: 当Lasry-Lions遇见Krugman：空间动力学的平均场博弈理论
title_secondary: When Lasry-Lions meet Krugman: A mean-field game theory of spatial dynamics
authors: M. Bahlali, R. Boucekkine, Q. Petit
official: 官方在线 2026-06-18 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We propose a mean-field game (MFG) approach to study the dynamics of spatial agglomeration in a continuous space-time framework where trade across locations may follow a broad class of static gravity models. Forward-looking intertemporal utility-maximizing agents work and migrate in a two-dimensional geography and face idiosyncratic shocks. Equilibrium wages and prices depend on their common distribution and adjust statically according to the underlying trade model. We first prove existence and uniqueness of the static trade equilibrium. We then prove existence of dynamic equilibria. In the case of a circular economy, we obtain closed-form solutions for small perturbations around the steady state, and we identify the sets of parameters that lead to agglomeration or dispersion. We exploit the MFG structure of the model to explicitly quantify how uncertainty and forward-looking expectations contribute to agglomeration and dispersion. In particular, we show that, regardless of the static trade model, forward-looking expectations always promote agglomeration, but cannot reverse the dominant pattern that would arise under myopic behavior.
abstract_zh: 我们提出一种平均场博弈（MFG）方法，用以研究连续时空框架下空间集聚的动态过程，其中跨地区贸易可能遵循一类广泛的静态引力模型。具有前瞻性跨期效用最大化的个体在二维地理空间中工作与迁移，并面临异质性冲击。均衡工资与价格取决于他们的共同分布，并根据底层贸易模型静态调整。我们首先证明静态贸易均衡的存在性与唯一性。随后证明动态均衡的存在性。在环形经济情形下，我们获得了稳态附近小扰动的闭式解，并识别出导致集聚或分散的参数集合。我们利用模型的MFG结构，明确量化不确定性与前瞻性预期对集聚和分散的贡献。特别地，我们表明，无论静态贸易模型如何，前瞻性预期总是促进集聚，但无法逆转在短视行为下将占主导地位的格局。

title: No man’s land? The effect of forced displacement on forest cover change in Colombia
title_zh: 无人之地？强迫迁移对哥伦比亚森林覆盖变化的影响
title_primary: 无人之地？强迫迁移对哥伦比亚森林覆盖变化的影响
title_secondary: No man’s land? The effect of forced displacement on forest cover change in Colombia
authors: Emilio Leguízamo, Ana María Montoya
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Globally, state-based armed conflict has increased by more than 50 percent over the past decade. The environmental consequences of such conflict are often overlooked. To help fill that gap, we examine the effect on forest cover of conflict-related forced displacement in Colombia. We use fine-scale annual data on forest cover change derived from satellite images along with data culled from court records of displacement events, using computational text analysis, to estimate staggered difference-in-differences models. We find that displacement leads to a 50 percent increase in deforestation. This effect is likely due to the expansion of both legal and illegal economic activities following displacement. It is most pronounced when paramilitary groups are the sole actors involved in displacement and where economic returns to cleared land uses are high. In principle, these results could be used to target efforts to reduce environmental damage associated with civil conflict.
abstract_zh: 全球范围内，过去十年间国家间武装冲突增加了超过50%。此类冲突的环境后果往往被忽视。为填补这一空白，我们研究了哥伦比亚因冲突导致的被迫流离失所对森林覆盖的影响。我们利用卫星图像获取的高分辨率年度森林覆盖变化数据，以及通过计算文本分析从法院记录中提取的流离失所事件数据，估计了交错双重差分模型。研究发现，流离失所导致森林砍伐率增加50%。这一效应可能源于流离失所后合法与非法经济活动的扩张。当准军事团体是流离失所事件的唯一参与方，且清理土地用途的经济回报较高时，该效应最为显著。原则上，这些结果可用于指导减少与国内冲突相关的环境损害的努力。

title_zh: 高素质农民培育何以驱动县域经济发展——基于新型职业农民培育示范政策的实证研究

abstract: 在城乡融合背景下，培育一批“有文化、懂技术、善经营、会管理”的高素质农民，对于壮大新型农业农村人才队伍、改善农村人力资本结构以及助力县域经济发展具有重要意义。本文借助新型职业农民培育示范政策实施这一准自然实验，将2011-2022年1762个县域层面的面板数据与“浙大卡特-企研中国涉农研究数据库”相匹配，采用渐进双重差分模型识别该政策实施对县域经济发展的影响及其作用机制。研究结果表明，新型职业农民...

title: Applying real options theory to farmers’ afforestation decisions in Ireland
title_zh: 应用实物期权理论分析爱尔兰农民造林决策
title_primary: 应用实物期权理论分析爱尔兰农民造林决策
title_secondary: Applying real options theory to farmers’ afforestation decisions in Ireland
authors: Laqiqige Zhu, Martha O’Hagan-Luff
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Farm afforestation is central to climate and biodiversity goals in Ireland, yet farmer uptake remains persistently low despite decades of generous government incentives. This paper investigates the drivers of reluctance through the lens of Real Options Theory, which emphasises the value of waiting under conditions of irreversibility and uncertainty. Drawing on 24 in-depth interviews with Irish farmers, the study uses thematic analysis to inductively identify how farmers frame afforestation and then deductively interprets these themes through the three pillars of the ROT: irreversibility, uncertainty and flexibility. The study demonstrates that hesitation is not a failure of rationality but its expression. Farmers consistently described afforestation as uniquely risky compared to alternative land uses, citing profound irreversibility (legal, financial, and socio-cultural), multidimensional uncertainties (policy, market, biological, and social), and the attractiveness of more flexible alternatives. Together, these conditions elevate the option value of delay, rationalising inaction despite the financial incentives on offer. Theoretically, the paper extends Real Options Theory beyond its traditional focus on price volatility to encompass institutional and socio-cultural dimensions of irreversibility and uncertainty. Methodologically, it demonstrates the value of qualitative inquiry to capture how farmers perceive and assign option value. This study contributes to land-use policy debates by integrating behavioural insights with investment-under-u
abstract_zh: 农场造林对于爱尔兰的气候和生物多样性目标至关重要，然而尽管政府提供了数十年的慷慨激励，农民的参与度却持续低迷。本文通过实物期权理论的视角探讨了农民犹豫不决的驱动因素，该理论强调在不可逆性和不确定性条件下等待的价值。基于对爱尔兰农民的24次深度访谈，本研究采用主题分析，先归纳性地识别农民如何构建造林议题，再通过实物期权理论的三大支柱——不可逆性、不确定性和灵活性——对这些主题进行演绎性解读。研究表明，犹豫并非理性的失败，而是理性的体现。农民一致认为，与其他土地利用方式相比，造林具有独特的风险性，他们提到了深层次的不可逆性（法律、财务和社会文化层面）、多维度的不确定性（政策、市场、生物和社会层面）以及更具吸引力的灵活替代方案。这些条件共同提升了延迟的期权价值，使得即使有经济激励，不作为也显得合理。在理论上，本文将实物期权理论从传统的价格波动关注扩展到制度和社

title: Firm-level production networks: What do we (really) know?
title_zh: 企业层面的生产网络：我们（真正）了解什么？
title_primary: 企业层面的生产网络：我们（真正）了解什么？
title_secondary: Firm-level production networks: What do we (really) know?
authors: Andrea Bacilieri, András Borsos, Pablo Astudillo-Estévez, Mads Hoefer, François Lafond
source: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-03-26 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Are standard production network properties similar across all available datasets, and if not, why? We provide benchmark results from two administrative datasets (Ecuador and Hungary), which are exceptional in that they have no reporting threshold. We compare these networks with a leading commercial dataset (FactSet) and published results on national firm-level production networks. Administrative datasets with no reporting thresholds have remarkably similar quantitative properties, while a number of important properties are biased in datasets with missing data.
abstract_zh: 标准生产网络属性在所有可用数据集中是否相似？若否，原因何在？我们提供了来自两个行政数据集（厄瓜多尔和匈牙利）的基准结果，这些数据集因其无报告门槛而尤为特殊。我们将这些网络与领先的商业数据集（FactSet）及已发表的关于国家企业级生产网络的结果进行比较。无报告门槛的行政数据集在定量属性上表现出显著相似性，而含缺失数据的数据集中若干重要属性则存在偏差。

title: The price impacts of renewable power: A tale of two sources
title_zh: 可再生能源电力的价格影响：两种来源的故事
title_primary: 可再生能源电力的价格影响：两种来源的故事
title_secondary: The price impacts of renewable power: A tale of two sources
authors: David P. Brown, Mar Reguant
official: 官方在线 2026-03-12 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines how the rapid expansion of wind and solar generation in Spain has reshaped wholesale electricity prices, ancillary service (AS) market costs, and market structure. Using an empirical strategy that exploits exogenous variation in renewable potential, we estimate how market outcomes would have differed under lower renewable capacity (and subsequently, renewable output). We find that rising wind and solar output substantially reduced wholesale prices. However, these reductions are partially offset by increases in AS market procurement and the associated operating costs driven by congestion and other operational challenges of variable generation. We show that while renewable growth reduces concentration in the wholesale market, AS markets remain highly concentrated, with limited scope for competition in key market segments. Our results highlight both the substantial net consumer benefits of renewable expansion on final prices (wholesale plus AS markets), while demonstrating the need for AS market reforms to reduce market concentration and cost-effectively manage increasing levels of renewable generation.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了西班牙风电和光伏发电的快速扩张如何重塑了批发电价、辅助服务（AS）市场成本及市场结构。利用一种利用可再生能源潜力外生变化的实证策略，我们估算了在较低可再生能源容量（及随后的可再生能源产出）下市场结果将有何不同。我们发现，风电和光伏产出的增加显著降低了批发价格。然而，这些降幅部分被辅助服务市场采购及其相关运营成本的增加所抵消，这些成本源于拥堵和可变发电的其他运营挑战。我们表明，尽管可再生能源增长降低了批发市场的集中度，但辅助服务市场仍高度集中，关键市场细分领域的竞争空间有限。我们的结果凸显了可再生能源扩张对最终价格（批发加辅助服务市场）带来的显著净消费者利益，同时证明了辅助服务市场改革的必要性，以降低市场集中度并成本有效地管理日益增长的可再生能源发电水平。

title: Imported intermediate digital inputs and income inequality
title_zh: 进口中间数字投入与收入不平等
title_primary: 进口中间数字投入与收入不平等
title_secondary: Imported intermediate digital inputs and income inequality
authors: Yanne Gabriella Velomasy, Yueling Wei, Hongsheng Zhang, Laixun Zhao
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-01-21 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper analyzes the impacts of importing intermediate digital inputs (IDIs) on income inequality between high-skilled and low-skilled workers, using a novel dataset that merges recent EU KLEMS and OECD data for 29 countries and 15 industries for 2008-2020. We find that IDI imports significantly widen income inequality, because such imports are associated with higher technology and capital intensities, which directly increase income inequality by complementing high-skilled labor while substituting for low-skilled labor, and indirectly exacerbate inequality through workforce skill upgrading. Heterogeneity analysis shows that these occur primarily in highly digitalized countries and industries, as well as technology-intensive sectors. We also construct two shift-share instrumental variables, namely the global imported IDI shocks and the global digital export shocks, to address endogeneity.
abstract_zh: 本文利用一项结合近期EU KLEMS与OECD数据的新数据集，涵盖2008-2020年间29个国家及15个行业，分析了进口中间数字投入（IDIs）对高技能与低技能工人之间收入不平等的影响。研究发现，IDI进口显著扩大了收入不平等，原因在于此类进口与更高的技术和资本密集度相关联，这直接通过补充高技能劳动力并替代低技能劳动力加剧了收入不平等，同时通过劳动力技能升级间接加剧了不平等。异质性分析显示，这些效应主要出现在高度数字化国家及行业，以及技术密集型部门。我们还构建了两个转移份额工具变量，即全球进口IDI冲击和全球数字出口冲击，以解决内生性问题。

title: Food without fire: Environmental and nutritional impacts from a solar stove field experiment
title_zh: 无火之炊：太阳能炉灶实地实验的环境与营养影响
title_primary: 无火之炊：太阳能炉灶实地实验的环境与营养影响
title_secondary: Food without fire: Environmental and nutritional impacts from a solar stove field experiment
authors: Laura E. McCann, Jeffrey D. Michler, Maybin Mwangala, Osaretin Olurotimi, Natalia Estrada Carmona
official: 官方在线 2025-11-05 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Over 80% of the population in rural Sub-Saharan Africa relies on biomass cooking fuel, a substantial source of anthropogenic greenhouse gases. We use a field experiment in Zambia to investigate the impact of solar stoves on biomass fuel use and cooking habits. Participants kept detailed food diaries, recording every ingredient and fuel source used in preparing every dish in every meal every day during the experiment. This produces data on 93,000 ingredients used to prepare 30,000 dishes. Treated households significantly reduce biomass fuel use, cutting emissions by 3–7%, but do not significantly change cooking habits.
abstract_zh: 撒哈拉以南非洲农村地区超过80%的人口依赖生物质烹饪燃料，这是人为温室气体的重要来源。我们利用赞比亚的一项实地实验，研究太阳能灶对生物质燃料使用和烹饪习惯的影响。参与者详细记录食物日记，在实验期间每天记录每餐每道菜所用到的每种食材和燃料来源。这产生了用于准备30,000道菜的93,000种食材的数据。处理组家庭显著减少了生物质燃料的使用，将排放量降低了3%至7%，但烹饪习惯并未发生显著变化。

title: Counting the days: parenthood and the gender gap in absenteeism
title_zh: 计算天数：育儿与缺勤中的性别差距
title_primary: 计算天数：育儿与缺勤中的性别差距
title_secondary: Counting the days: parenthood and the gender gap in absenteeism
authors: Philip J. Rosenbaum
official: 官方在线 2025-09-25 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study is the first to estimate the effect of parenthood on total job absences, including both short- and long-term spells. Unlike prior work on formal sick leave records, I incorporate day-to-day absences, which account for most absence events and reflect broader margins of health and time strain. I find that mothers’ absences increase by 1.25 days per month 2 years after birth, stabilizing at 0.85 days – a 4.6–5.7% loss in annual workdays. The penalty is driven mainly by mothers’ own sickness and concentrated in long spells. It is largely unaffected by working hour or within-couple bargaining power. These findings uncover an overlooked mechanism behind the child penalty and deepen our understanding of gender inequality in labour supply.

title: A New Keynesian Phillips curve estimation for a small open economy in the presence of structural changes: empirical evidence from Turkey
title_zh: 结构变化下小型开放经济体的新凯恩斯菲利普斯曲线估计：来自土耳其的经验证据
title_primary: 结构变化下小型开放经济体的新凯恩斯菲利普斯曲线估计：来自土耳其的经验证据
title_secondary: A New Keynesian Phillips curve estimation for a small open economy in the presence of structural changes: empirical evidence from Turkey
authors: Salih Yildirim Kadir Y. Eryigit a Department of Economics, Bursa Uludağ University, Bursa, Turkeyb Department of Econometrics, Turkey
official: 官方在线 2025-08-08 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study aims to model inflation dynamics by presenting the evidence supporting instability of the Phillips curve for the period covering the explicit inflation targeting (IT) adoption in Turkey as a small open economy. To this end, Bai and Perron approach is applied to capture possible breaks or instability associated with the structural changes in the hybrid New Keynesian Phillips curve (NKPC) estimation, using quarterly data from 2006:q1 to 2023:q4. The empirical findings reveal that the hybrid model of the NKPC with the control variables gives unstable parameter estimations with significant structural breaks which can be related to some structural changes the Turkish economy experienced for post IT periods. The results also put forward that the inflation-output gap relationship produces larger amount of parameter in high inflation period implying that the Phillips curve steepens with changing price setting behaviour and the effects of reel exchange rate and oil prices on domestic inflation rate. Based on these findings, the weaker anchored expectations may increase the output cost because of the changing trade-off between inflation and output gap. The Central Bank of the Republic of Turkey (CBRT) should take its unstable structure into account in the inflation targeting process.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在通过呈现支持土耳其这一小型开放经济体在明确采纳通胀目标制（IT）期间菲利普斯曲线不稳定性的证据，来对通胀动态进行建模。为此，采用Bai和Perron方法，以捕捉混合新凯恩斯菲利普斯曲线（NKPC）估计中与结构性变化相关的可能断点或不稳定性，使用2006年第一季度至2023年第四季度的季度数据。实证结果表明，包含控制变量的NKPC混合模型给出了不稳定的参数估计，并伴有显著的结构性断点，这些断点可能与土耳其在后通胀目标制时期经历的一些结构性变化有关。结果还指出，在高通胀时期，通胀-产出缺口关系产生的参数值更大，这意味着菲利普斯曲线随着价格设定行为的变化而变得更加陡峭，同时实际汇率和石油价格对国内通胀率也有影响。基于这些发现，较弱的锚定预期可能因通胀与产出缺口之间权衡关系的改变而增加产出成本。土耳其共和国中央银行（CBRT）在通胀目标制过程中应考虑其不稳定的结构。

title: Better city, better life: smart city policy and corporate ESG performance
title_zh: 智慧城市，美好生活：智慧城市政策与企业ESG表现
title_primary: 智慧城市，美好生活：智慧城市政策与企业ESG表现
title_secondary: Better city, better life: smart city policy and corporate ESG performance
authors: Yao Zhou, Meng Meng, Jingjing Gao
official: 官方在线 2025-07-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Using data from Chinese listed companies, this study examines the overall impact of the smart city policy (SCP) on corporate environmental, social, and governance (ESG) performance, focusing on the distinct effects across the E, S, and G dimensions. Using a multiperiod difference-in-differences (DID) approach, we analyse 24647 firm-year observations from 2009 to 2021, leveraging the three-stage SCP rollout as a quasi-natural experiment. The results indicate that the SCP improves corporate ESG scores by approximately 0.04, with significant enhancements in governance performance. Mechanism analysis also reveals that the SCP fosters ESG improvements through increased R&D investments and market attention, while executive environmental awareness has limited effects. Policy impacts also vary by ownership and industry, with state-owned enterprises, industrial firms, and companies in low-pollution and high-technology sectors obtaining the greatest benefits. Robustness checks, including alternative models and PSM-DID estimations, confirm these findings. Moreover, interaction analysis indicates that the SCP and other sustainability-focused policies (e.g. green credit and resource city policies) act as substitutes rather than complements due to policy priority and resource constraints for companies. Our findings underscore the importance of a coordinated policy design to maximize the collective effectiveness of policies in promoting sustainable corporate practices.
abstract_zh: 基于中国上市公司数据，本研究考察了智慧城市政策（SCP）对企业环境、社会和治理（ESG）绩效的整体影响，重点关注其在E、S、G三个维度上的差异化效应。采用多期双重差分（DID）方法，我们分析了2009年至2021年间24647个公司-年度观测值，将三阶段SCP推广作为准自然实验。结果表明，SCP使企业ESG得分提升约0.04，其中治理绩效的改善尤为显著。机制分析进一步揭示，SCP通过增加研发投入和市场关注度促进ESG改善，而高管环境意识的影响有限。政策效应因所有权性质和行业类型而异，国有企业、工业企业以及低污染和高科技行业的企业获益最大。包括替代模型和倾向得分匹配双重差分（PSM-DID）估计在内的稳健性检验证实了上述发现。此外，交互效应分析表明，由于政策优先级和企业资源约束，SCP与其他可持续发展导向政策（如绿色信贷政策和资源型城市政策）呈现替代而非互补关系。本研究结果强调了协调政策设计对于最大化政策组合在促进企业可持续实践方面整体效能的重要性。
